description: This is a PHP source file defining the 'ServerRequest' class in the GuzzleHttp\Psr7 namespace. It extends the Request class to implement server-side HTTP request handling, including parsing server variables, managing uploaded files, cookies, query parameters, and request attributes. It also provides static methods to create instances from global PHP variables, normalize uploaded files, and extract URI information from server globals.

classes.name: ServerRequest
classes.description: Represents a server-side HTTP request, extending the base Request class with additional methods for accessing server parameters, cookies, query parameters, uploaded files, and attributes. It includes static methods to instantiate from PHP globals and to handle uploaded files.

methods.name: normalizeFiles
methods.description: Normalizes the structure of uploaded files array into a consistent array of UploadedFileInterface instances.

methods.name: createUploadedFileFromSpec
methods.description: Creates an UploadedFile instance from a $_FILES specification array. Delegates to normalizeNestedFileSpec if the input is an array of files.

methods.name: normalizeNestedFileSpec
methods.description: Normalizes nested file specifications into an array of UploadedFileInterface instances.

methods.name: fromGlobals
methods.description: Creates a ServerRequest instance populated with PHP superglobals ($_GET, $_POST, $_COOKIE, $_FILES, $_SERVER).

methods.name: getUriFromGlobals
methods.description: Constructs a UriInterface instance based on server variables such as REQUEST_URI, SERVER_NAME, SERVER_PORT, etc.
